newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen surging on anti-Bhutto ruling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen surging on anti-Bhutto ruling.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to surge on Thursday after the Supreme Court upheld President Farooq Leghari's removal of former prime minister Benazir Bhutto, dealers said.

"Market expectations have been fulfilled," analyst Muddassar Malik of BMA Capital Management said. The 100-share index might surge 60 to 70 points on Thursday on hopes that Bhutto's rival Nawaz Sharif will win Monday's general election, he added.
The Karachi index rose 11.31 points, or 0.75 percent, to end at 1,512.15. Gainers led losers 126 to 97. Turnover rose to 40.28 million shares from 35.06 million in the previous session.
